description: Main React application component for the notes application, responsible for managing state, handling CRUD operations, and rendering the core layout including sidebar, header, and detail views.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from the API and updates state.

methods.name: handleAddNote
methods.description: Opens the dialog for adding a new note.

methods.name: handleEditNote
methods.description: Opens the dialog to edit an existing note.

methods.name: handleDialogSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the note dialog for creating or updating a note.

methods.name: handleSidebarToggle
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the sidebar on mobile.
